all.src: Net credit >= 18% of width (a condor collects from two sides, so the per-side hurdle is lower than the single vertical's 20%).
Max loss per position <= 1% of equity ($500 on $50k); at most 2 concurrent 0DTE condors; total 0DTE defined risk <= 3% of equity per day.
All four legs OI >= 1000, one MLeg limit order at the mid, chase no more than $0.02.

management.src: Take profit at 50% of credit, or any time after 15:00 ET the whole structure closes for <= $0.05.
Stop loss at 2.0x the credit received on the structure.
Delta stop: close the tested side when its short strike's locally computed delta reaches 0.30; the untested side may be left to decay only if its own delta is below 0.05.
Touch stop: close immediately if the underlying trades through either short strike.
After 15:00 ET tighten the profit target to 35% of credit.

exits.src: If a closing order is unfilled by 15:40 ET, reprice to the natural every 10 seconds until filled and log a critical incident; halt new 0DTE entries until reviewed.
